t: Looking up, you see 30 St Mary Axe, the skyscraper everyone calls the Gherkin because of its shape. It has 41 floors and stands 180 metres tall. It was completed in December 2003 and opened in April 2004. It stands on the sites of the former Baltic Exchange and Chamber of Shipping, which were badly damaged by an IRA bomb in 1992. Norman Foster, a pioneer of high-tech architecture, designed it, together with Ken Shuttleworth. It was previously known as the Swiss Re Building.
